title: [human] beads-worker-5 branch is 643 commits behind main — sync/rebase needed
description: Worker5's local branch (beads-worker-5) is 643 commits behind main with only 4 unpushed ahead-commits, and its merge-base predates many recent worker merges. Consequence: claimed beads repeatedly turn out to be ALREADY-FIXED on main (nbc6, j070 this round) or blocked by in-flight work my tree predates (b7z9.88.2 blocked by ow1e.111 newtype migration + qe1t sizing). The sync loop held /tmp/lichen-beads-sync.lock at the time. Request: either let the sync loop merge worker5's 4 commits and rebase the worker5 checkout onto current main, or confirm the intended worker-branch lifecycle so implementers stop working against a stale tree. Filed after closing two stale beads in one round.
